description:
Use this when the user wants clips removed from their Library: "delete this clip", "get rid of the bad ones".
It cannot be undone and RipClip keeps no copy, so ask the user to confirm which clips (names from list_clips)
first. The source video stays.
Not for: a post draft (delete_draft). Free: no Horizon Units.

clip_ids.description: Ids from list_clips of the clips to delete, up to 50 per call. If any id isn't the user's own or has expired, nothing is deleted.

name: delete_clip
title: Delete clips for good
